original_query: In which year did Nestlé achieve higher Organic Growth, 2003 or 2004?

confirmed.answer_text: Organic Growth in 2003 was 5.1%.; Organic Growth in 2004 was 4.5%.
confirmed.summary: The page presents a bar chart illustrating Nestlé's Organic Growth percentages from 2001 to 2011, with a line graph showing EBIT margin improvement over the same period. It also provides 10-year annual averages for Organic Growth and Real Internal Growth.
